scripts.deploy: bash utils/bash/validate-env-deploy.sh && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm -r run --workspace-concurrency=5 --report-summary cdk:deploy && pnpm -r run cdk:clean
scripts.deploy:15: bash utils/bash/validate-env-deploy.sh && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm -r run --workspace-concurrency=15 --report-summary cdk:deploy && pnpm -r run cdk:clean
scripts.deploy:migrations: bash utils/bash/validate-env-deploy.sh && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm --filter @kace/database run migrate:latest && pnpm -r run --workspace-concurrency=15 --report-summary cdk:deploy && pnpm -r run cdk:clean
scripts.deploy:apis: bash utils/bash/validate-env-deploy.sh && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm --filter @kace/database run migrate:latest && pnpm --filter './apps/apiv1/kace_cloud_api_*' run --workspace-concurrency=10 --report-summary cdk:deploy && pnpm -r run cdk:clean
